title: Mallworld based on real life?
content: How many peoples places in mallworld are based in real life? Virtually every place I go has at least some fingers in actual places. The hotels and malls are not the ones from my life, but they have the same names. The bizarre stripmalls, parking lots and streets aren't very accurate but they ARE distorted versions of places I know. Except the school, from the outside, is my real world high school. No distortion at all. Ever. The inside bears no resemblance but the outside...and the surrounding streets...are very accurate. There are plenty of places I've never seen IRL, but the majority are distortions of real places or are taking the place of real places. Having said all that, none of these places behave the way they should. I have to punch a time clock at the school, even though I know I don't have any reason to be there. The streets don't lead where I expect them to, the elevators are an endless source of frustration and I can never find what I'm looking for. Is this typical?
